gregSvoboda.quote: I use David’s avatar everywhere I can. It being hand-drawn has made all the difference. People at conferences have met me and said “I recognized you from your avatar!” I’ll probably use it forever.
gregSvoboda.name: Greg Svoboda
gregSvoboda.role: Head of Developer Relations at Postmark
gregSvoboda.imageAlt: The black-and-white avatar David drew for Greg Svoboda

pieterDenHeten.quote: David is an all-round great person and wonderful artist. We need so much more of this in today’s world.
pieterDenHeten.name: Pieter den Heten
pieterDenHeten.imageAlt: The color avatar David drew for Pieter den Heten, surrounded by icons of his travels and interests

bernardoMartinez.quote: Uniquely creative, community driven and insightful. Don’t take my word, listen to one of his sessions.
bernardoMartinez.name: Bernardo Martinez
bernardoMartinez.imageAlt: The color avatar David drew for Bernardo Martinez

anthonyDellavecchia.quote: David drew my avatar years ago, and I still use it today (even if I look a little different these days!). He was incredibly gracious throughout the process and has been doing this for folks in DevRel for a long time. His art is genuinely hand-drawn (no AI) and it really shows. Truly talented, thank you so much!
anthonyDellavecchia.name: Anthony Dellavecchia
